title: Grading System
shortDesc: Enables creation of subjects, students, and grading per student.
longDesc:
Enables creation of subjects, students, and grading per student. Built with C# and MongoDB for efficient data management.

Features:
• Subject management (add, edit, delete)
• Student enrollment and records
• Grade entry with automatic computation
• Report generation (PDF/Excel)
• User authentication with role-based access
• Audit trail for all changes
